hul_plotter.text: Upstairs is the Plotting Parlour. Story goes Sir John Hotham decided there to shut Beverley Gate on the King in 1642. Whether he did or not, the beer's been good ever since.
There's a skull in a case behind the bar. Nobody knows whose. Best not to ask after your second pint.

hul_landlady.text: Nah then, duck. Quiz night, every night. Northern questions, northern prizes.
